summary: Frontend walkthrough of the 4 demo-video flows on PREVIEW (Partner, Supplier consent, Sealed bids/committee opening, Escrow EMD). Partner portal, supplier consent page, supplier portal, public homepage/tenders, admin sealed-bid view and escrow ledger all load with meaningful demo content. BLOCKER for video 3: committee members (committee1/2) have NO UI to approve the bid opening — /staff has no opening panel and /admin/* redirects them to /staff; admin sees the panel but is not a member so no approve buttons. Backend approve works (verified via API with both committee members -> technical envelopes OPENED 2026-10-31 07:34, 2 bids). Several demo-seed gaps make screens look empty/broken (admin Notices empty, escrow 'SIGNATORY REQUIRED' warning, empty escrow volume chart, untitled bids).

minor.issue: Returns 0 items: the demo notices were seeded without tenant_id (query filters tenant_id=PMC-KZ-01). Result: Admin > Notices shows 'No published notices yet', Escrow institutions > Notice<->Escrow routing shows 'No published notices yet'. Fix seed: add tenant_id 'PMC-KZ-01' to all DEMO notices.

Escrow volume chart empty ('No transaction history') because seeded escrow_institutions.signatories=[] so _resolve_joint_account_ids finds 0 joint accounts (joint_account_count 0). Fix seed: signatories=[{name:'James Okafor (Demo)', email:'escrow@demo.pmcmanagers.com'}].

ui_bugs.issue: No reachable UI for committee_member to approve opening. StaffDashboard.jsx never renders BidOpeningPanel; staff-type accounts are redirected away from /admin/e/bidding and /admin/bids/:id. Admin can see the panel but i_can_approve=false (not a member). Video 3 cannot be recorded as specified.
committee1 signs in with active role 'Site Certifier' by default (role probe order); user must switch the ROLE dropdown to 'Bid Committee' manually.
'VALUE IN PLAY (USD) $0' although the active bid is £84,500 (sealed/GBP not counted) and 'EMD PAID $1,000' shows a $ sign for a GBP 1,000 deposit.

Demo account shows red 'SIGNATORY REQUIRED' badge, 'PMC officer email is not in the escrow-signatory staff pool' and a red ✗ next to committee1 — looks broken on camera. Seed should give committee1 the escrow signatory role/pool entry or use a pool officer.
Both demo bids display '(Untitled bid)' and price '—'; better to show the tender title.

integration_issues.issue: Works (200 application/pdf, opens in new tab via blob) but the month picker defaults to the previous month (2026-09) which produces an empty statement; presenter must pick October 2026 first. Also after 1 Nov all 'this month' leaderboard/badges/Partners of the month will reset — record before month end or re-seed.

Make committee_member the default active role for committee accounts (or seed committee1/2 with roles ['committee_member'] only).
RE-SEED demo data: technical envelopes of DEMO-TND-OPEN were opened during this test (approved by committee1 'Priya Shah' + committee2 'Tom Ellis' via API at 2026-10-31 07:34).

Seed fixes: add tenant_id 'PMC-KZ-01' to DEMO notices (admin Notices + escrow routing empty); add signatories [{escrow@demo.pmcmanagers.com}] to the escrow institution (chart empty); put committee1 in escrow-signatory pool or choose a pool officer (removes 'SIGNATORY REQUIRED'); set bid title/notice_title so Bidding ops doesn't show '(Untitled bid)'.
